title: eupatorium tepicanum
intro: Eupatorium tepicanum, commonly known as Mountain Silver Top, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in reducing inflammation and pain. The health benefits of Eupatorium tepicanum include its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic actions, which may aid in alleviating conditions such as fever and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
